llms.body:
# Rootlake

> Rootlake LLC measures how mobile networks perform in the real world, and where. The data
> is collected first-party through Rootlake's own SDK, integrated by mobile app developers,
> and licensed to companies that build analytics and intelligence products on top of it.
> Rootlake is a data provider, not an advertising company.

## What Rootlake provides

Cellular network performance measurements — how a network is behaving on a device at a
given moment — together with location context for devices whose users have granted location
permission, and basic technical attributes such as device type and connection details.

Partners are typically location intelligence platforms, mobility and market analytics firms,
data platforms that build their own products on the feed, and telecom and infrastructure
companies working on coverage and benchmarking.

## How it is collected

App developers integrate the Rootlake SDK into their mobile applications. Measurements are
taken on the device only after the end user has given consent through the app's consent
management platform and granted the relevant permissions. Nothing is purchased from
advertising exchanges or third-party brokers, and location is never inferred from IP
addresses.

## Coverage

Markets across Europe, Latin America and Asia. The panel grows as new publishers integrate
the SDK, so coverage by country changes over time. Current breakdowns are shared with
prospective partners on request.

## Privacy position

- Consent is the lawful basis for everything collected, captured before any measurement is taken.
- Rootlake does not collect names, email addresses, phone numbers, message content or browsing history. Identifiers in the data are pseudonymous.
- Rootlake operates under the GDPR, the UK GDPR and the Swiss FADP, with appropriate transfer mechanisms and appointed representatives in the EU and the UK.
- Rootlake does not serve advertising and does not profile people for ad targeting.
- Licenses prohibit identifying or tracking individuals, inferring sensitive characteristics, and any use for government surveillance or law-enforcement targeting.
- End users can opt out at https://rootlake.io/opt-out or via privacy@rootlake.io.

## Delivery

Server-to-server, on a regular schedule, to a dedicated access-controlled location in a
format agreed with the partner. Technical specifications are shared under a mutual
non-disclosure agreement.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rootlake.io/): what Rootlake does and who it works with.
- [Our data](https://rootlake.io/data): how the data is collected, what it covers and how it is delivered.
- [FAQ](https://rootlake.io/faq): the questions Rootlake is asked most often.
- [Privacy Policy](https://rootlake.io/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://rootlake.io/terms)
- [Opt-out](https://rootlake.io/opt-out)

## Contact

- General and partnerships: contact@rootlake.io
- Privacy and data-subject requests: privacy@rootlake.io
- Legal: legal@rootlake.io
- Rootlake LLC, 30 N Gould St Ste N, Sheridan, WY 82801, USA

homepage.body:
AboutSolutionsContact us
Cellular data intelligence

Understand mobile networks
like never before.

Rootlake collects real-world cellular performance and location data from millions of devices. That gives telcos, analysts, and infrastructure companies the ground truth they need to make better decisions.

Get in touchLearn more

Trusted by companies globally

About

Real data from real devices.

Rootlake gathers cellular network measurements directly from mobile devices in the field: signal strength, latency, throughput, and precise location. This data powers coverage analysis, network benchmarking, and investment decisions for the companies that build and operate wireless infrastructure.

MillionsDaily measurements
GlobalWorldwide reach
All carriersNetwork data
Solutions

Data products for every use case.

📡

Coverage intelligence

Granular, ground-truth coverage maps built from real device measurements. Know exactly where networks perform, and where they don't.

📊

Network benchmarking

Compare carrier performance across regions with objective, crowd-sourced metrics. Ideal for analysts and regulatory bodies.

📍

Location analytics

Anonymized, aggregated location intelligence derived from mobile device activity, supporting infrastructure planning and market analysis.

🔗

Raw data feeds

Access cleaned, structured cellular measurement data via bulk delivery. Integrate directly into your own models and platforms.

Who we serve

Built for the telco ecosystem.

Mobile network operators

Validate and improve your coverage claims with independent, real-world data.

Tower companies

Identify underserved areas and optimize site selection with location-enriched signal data.

Industry analysts

Build reports and benchmarks your clients trust, backed by objective measurement data.

Regulators

Verify broadband coverage reports and allocate funding with confidence.

Contact

Let's talk data.

Interested in our data products or want to explore a partnership?
Reach out and our team will get back to you.
